title: FINANCEBOT agent-cadence tournament
positioning: Historical simulation evidence for an agent-evaluation system; not an investment product.
interpretation: Within this simulator and comparison window, invoking the agent more frequently did not produce better decisions: open + close review used 190 calls and returned 26.34%, while hourly review used 665 calls and returned 2.60%.
required_caveats: Current-listing-universe bias: the broad universe was assembled from current listings rather than a point-in-time membership source.
Paper execution assumptions: fills, costs, slippage, liquidity, and timing are simulated.
January selection and repeated-testing risk: January selected variants, and later inspection reduces claims of pristine out-of-sample evidence.
Short historical regime: February through mid-June does not establish robustness across market conditions.
Non-deterministic model decisions: model outputs may differ on rerun even when configuration is frozen.
No live capital: no result shown here came from a live brokerage account.

metric_notes.return: Paper-ledger ending equity divided by starting equity minus one.
metric_notes.max_drawdown: Largest peak-to-trough decline in the simulated equity snapshots.
metric_notes.reported_sharpe: Repository-reported statistic: square-root-of-252 times mean divided by population standard deviation of per-snapshot percentage changes. Snapshot frequency is intraday, so this is retained for comparison rather than presented as a conventional hourly annualization.
metric_notes.model_calls: Estimated from configured review invocations in aggregate tournament artifacts; not provider billing records.
metric_notes.benchmark: Buy-and-hold return over the same dates; it does not match exposure, concentration, turnover, or risk.
